full_judgment: 2. Short facts are that on 28.09.1987 the Complainant-opposite party-respondent No. 2 brought C.R. Case No. 415 of 1987 in the Court of Upazilla Magistrate at Debidwar alleging, inter alia, that she along with her two sons, namely P.W. Kamal Hossain and P.W Shain Mia purchased .4½ decimals land of plot No.111A appertaining to Khatian No. 236 of Mouza Debidwar under police Station Debidwar by a registered deed dated 15.02.1987 from accused No.2 Abdul Latif @ Hanif. Thereafter, the said accused Latif again sold out the same area of land to accused No.1 by another registered deed dated 30.08.1987 showing ante dated execution date on 09.01.1987 with a view to defraud the complainant.
